name: Mercenary Powershot
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Powershot (players/ranger/mercenary/powershot_merc.sval, 25 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 3 (in brackets): damage 175 (240); ignores 25% resistance (50%); cooldown 8 s (2 s). Its own mana 90, cooldown 8 s (2 s). Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon.
summary: Three charged arrows for up to 175 magical damage that ignore 25% resistance, on an 8 s cooldown.
